Key.Original: Ceiling on chromatic aberration from seeing and heat shimmer
Key.English: Ceiling on chromatic aberration from seeing and heat shimmer

Key.Original: Dew build-up speed per tick while condensing
Key.English: Dew build-up speed per tick while condensing

Key.Original: Lens-fog blur ceiling from condensation on optics
Key.English: Lens-fog blur ceiling from condensation on optics

Key.Original: Dew clearing speed per tick when conditions clear
Key.English: Dew clearing speed per tick when conditions clear

Key.Original: Veiling blur at peak solar glare
Key.English: Veiling blur at peak solar glare

Key.Original: Chromatic aberration from engine heat shimmer
Key.English: Chromatic aberration from engine heat shimmer

Key.Original: Show the environment HUD over the night-vision view: heading, grid, altitude, time and the aee temperature, humidity and wind
Key.English: Show the environment HUD over the night-vision view: heading, grid, altitude, time and the aee temperature, humidity and wind

Key.Original: Log optics diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.
Key.English: Log optics diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.

Key.Original: Show the aee MGRS reference and the terrain elevation at the map cursor. The vanilla cursor tooltip is engine-side and cannot be replaced, so the aee readout is drawn adjacent to it. Default on.
Key.English: Show the aee MGRS reference and the terrain elevation at the map cursor. The vanilla cursor tooltip is engine-side and cannot be replaced, so the aee readout is drawn adjacent to it. Default on.

Key.Original: Show the grid line as a full MGRS reference (zone, latitude band, 100 km square and digits) from the aee world-to-MGRS kernel instead of the engine numeric grid. Off restores the legacy numeric grid. Default on.
Key.English: Show the grid line as a full MGRS reference (zone, latitude band, 100 km square and digits) from the aee world-to-MGRS kernel instead of the engine numeric grid. Off restores the legacy numeric grid. Default on.

Key.Original: Draw the aee MGRS grid over the engine map: the grid lines and their MGRS labels at an interval that follows the zoom. The engine grid stays numeric because the CfgWorlds Grid class formats numbers only, so the aee overlay draws the MGRS lines over it. Default on.
Key.English: Draw the aee MGRS grid over the engine map: the grid lines and their MGRS labels at an interval that follows the zoom. The engine grid stays numeric because the CfgWorlds Grid class formats numbers only, so the aee overlay draws the MGRS lines over it. Default on.

Key.Original: Scale the MGRS digit count with the world map size. On: a small world gets a six-figure reference (100 m) and a large world an eight-figure one (10 m). Off: the MGRS Precision list applies. Default on.
Key.English: Scale the MGRS digit count with the world map size. On: a small world gets a six-figure reference (100 m) and a large world an eight-figure one (10 m). Off: the MGRS Precision list applies. Default on.

Key.Original: Number of MGRS digits, one of 4, 6, 8 or 10. Four digits is 1 km, six is 100 m, eight is 10 m and ten is 1 m. The digits label the south-west corner of the square and are truncated, not rounded. Default 10.
Key.English: Number of MGRS digits, one of 4, 6, 8 or 10. Four digits is 1 km, six is 100 m, eight is 10 m and ten is 1 m. The digits label the south-west corner of the square and are truncated, not rounded. Default 10.

Key.Original: Particle density of the heat-haze field
Key.English: Particle density of the heat-haze field

Key.Original: Sun angle gate for mirage, in degrees
Key.English: Sun angle gate for mirage, in degrees

Key.Original: Surface temperature at which mirage starts, in degrees Celsius
Key.English: Surface temperature at which mirage starts, in degrees Celsius

Key.Original: Droplet build-up speed per tick during rain
Key.English: Droplet build-up speed per tick during rain

Key.Original: Droplet clearing speed per tick when rain stops
Key.English: Droplet clearing speed per tick when rain stops

Key.Original: Long-range shimmer strength from atmospheric seeing
Key.English: Long-range shimmer strength from atmospheric seeing

Key.Original: Scale on the snow blindness dazzle overlay
Key.English: Scale on the snow blindness dazzle overlay

Key.Original: Scale on god-ray brightness from solar glare
Key.English: Scale on god-ray brightness from solar glare

Key.Original: Draw the NATO APP-6(C) map and world symbols over the engine markers and unit icons. The layer hides the engine mission markers locally and restores them when the map closes. The engine 3D unit icons cannot be suppressed and remain. Default off.
Key.English: Draw the NATO APP-6(C) map and world symbols over the engine markers and unit icons. The layer hides the engine mission markers locally and restores them when the map closes. The engine 3D unit icons cannot be suppressed and remain. Default off.

Key.Original: Use the AEE font for the symbology labels when the font assets are present. Off keeps the engine font. The font conversion is an operator step. Default on.
Key.English: Use the AEE font for the symbology labels when the font assets are present. Off keeps the engine font. The font conversion is an operator step. Default on.

Key.Original: Draw the symbology symbols for the engine map markers. Off leaves the markers to the engine. Default on.
Key.English: Draw the symbology symbols for the engine map markers. Off leaves the markers to the engine. Default on.

Key.Original: Choose whose side is blue: NATO fixes WEST, OPFOR fixes EAST, Auto follows the local side. The frame shape and the colour then follow the standard. Default Auto.
Key.English: Choose whose side is blue: NATO fixes WEST, OPFOR fixes EAST, Auto follows the local side. The frame shape and the colour then follow the standard. Default Auto.

Key.Original: Suppress the engine map indicators where the engine allows it and hide the engine mission markers locally while the map is open. The call is disableMapIndicators; the hide is local and restored on close. Default on.
Key.English: Suppress the engine map indicators where the engine allows it and hide the engine mission markers locally while the map is open. The call is disableMapIndicators; the hide is local and restored on close. Default on.

Key.Original: Draw the symbology symbols for the in-range units. Off draws the markers and the player only. Default on.
Key.English: Draw the symbology symbols for the in-range units. Off draws the markers and the player only. Default on.

Key.Original: Show the signal-dependent tracker in place of the exact friendly positions. The tracker applies the aee GNSS error-ellipse, fix-state and datalink kernels to your own group, and draws fuzzy markers with an uncertainty ellipse on the map and the HUD. Default off.
Key.English: Show the signal-dependent tracker in place of the exact friendly positions. The tracker applies the aee GNSS error-ellipse, fix-state and datalink kernels to your own group, and draws fuzzy markers with an uncertainty ellipse on the map and the HUD. Default off.

Key.Original: Seconds between tracker model updates for the local group, range 0.2 to 5. A longer interval costs less and ages the tracks more. Default 1.0.
Key.English: Seconds between tracker model updates for the local group, range 0.2 to 5. A longer interval costs less and ages the tracks more. Default 1.0.

Key.Original: Suppress the engine friendly map indicators where the engine allows it. The call is disableMapIndicators, which acts only when the difficulty exposes extended map content; it is local and re-applied. setGroupIconsVisible cannot hide the engine markers. Default off.
Key.English: Suppress the engine friendly map indicators where the engine allows it. The call is disableMapIndicators, which acts only when the difficulty exposes extended map content; it is local and re-applied. setGroupIconsVisible cannot hide the engine markers. Default off.
